column3: Strange Menu
Welcome back, Master, Mistress!
*sigh* I'm still not used to this.
While I was thinking, the otaku trio are walking beside me as if it was natural.
I ordered a Black Bean Recovery Potion after taking a seat, which is basically, iced coffee.
Kirino ordered a Spirits of Saiyan. Kuroneko ordered a Superb God Water, Saori got a Holy Tree Essence.
Why don't they use any normal names for this cafe's menu?
Well then, to celebrate the glorious victory---
Cheers!
Cheers.
Cheers it is!
Cheers.
Haaa.
The iced coffee penetrated my tired body...!
Come to think of it, you three wore maid outfits before.
Ah, it's true there was such a thing. It was probably around winter.
That's right.
We reserved a rental room where Kiririn-shi, Kuroneko-shi and I comforted Kyousuke-shi.
Pfft!
You! Why are you saying such things in public? What if it gets taken the wrong way?!
Huhuhu, sorry about that. But well, I really missed that.
I still remember the maid outfits really suited Kiririn-shi and Kuroneko-shi well - absolutely cute.
...P-Please do forget about that time.
Heh, what are you so embarrassed about? It was cute, your cat-eared maid!
Wha...
I still have a picture on my phone, wanna see?
D-Delete those!
Nope. I plan on showing them to your kids years later!
This is taking a prank too far.
Besides, this means she plans to remain Kuroneko's friend for the years to come.
C-Come to think of it, you gave your elder brother an outrageous gift.
Wha...! T-That has nothing to do with this?
It was something like 'Please treasure it as you treasure me', right? Something lovers would say.
Ahhhhhhhh! Shut up shut up shut up! Forget about that!
Hehe.
Heh.
Yep.
Those are important memories made in Akihabara for the four of us.
We all made many memories in this part of town.
Good or bad, many things happened.
Accumulated memories, the kind of which you won't forget, treasuring them throughout your life.
I hope they feel the same.
Ah! That reminds me!
Kirino promptly took out a music player.
Hey you, listen to this.
Huh?
Hurry!
Okay, okay.
Whoa... W-What's going on, this 【denpa song】?!
I'm completely unsure whether this was recorded properly or not.
There's electronic sounds popping midway.
There is also sudden shifting of melody.
It's similar to the Meruru song I know of.
Hmm?! Hmm?! This song is awesome, isn't it?!
My ears are about to fall off!
Huh? What are you saying?! You don't see the merits of this song?
Who is it! The person who wrote such a senseless song!
...Huh? What are you saying?
...Uh, don't tell me...
The person that made this song is... ME!
Whoa...! Such a murderous aura...?!
